name: openasi-checkin
description: OpenASI 每日签到：零依赖轻量脚本（模拟真实客户端请求）与 Playwright 完整版（自动刷新会话），支持状态查询与退出码语义。

interface.longDescription: Run and check the daily check-in for OpenASI (app.openasi.bitmiracle.cn). Uses a zero-dependency script that replays the real client request, and falls back to a Playwright session refresh when the token expires.
